items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That band, Joe Haider, we were co-leaders.

ctx.x: We ended yesterday talking about your time in Europe. I know I’d asked you about – is it Joe Haider? How do you say it?

That’s just a name that popped out in going through discographies and other things. Would you touch on some of the bands that you – some of the large bands that you played there, and some of the composing or maybe commissions that you executed that you particularly would want in the record?
